name: Vesper
tagline: Multi-day option buying on NSE stocks
summary: Vesper buys one stock option on each signal across 43 NSE stocks and holds it overnight, typically for a few days: a call when Firefly's rules turn up, a put when they turn down. It trades far less often than the intraday strategies, and exits on a trend reversal, a target or a stop.
risk: Option buyers can lose the whole premium paid on a trade. These results are before brokerage, taxes and slippage; stock options trade with wider spreads than index options, so real fills would be worse than the prices used here. At its busiest this backtest had about ₹3.3 lakh of premium open at once, more than the ₹2 lakh starting capital; the percentage figures are measured on the starting capital.
